rows.name: Sample Lending
farm_steps: Use a fresh wallet that holds only the funds you plan to farm, and keep its seed phrase offline. Cost: under $15 of gas for the first transaction. Time: 5 minutes.
Supply $100 of USDC to Sample Lending on Ethereum and keep the position open. Cost: $100 of capital and about $10 of gas. Time: 15 minutes to set up.
Make one qualifying action each week, such as a deposit, a borrow, a swap or a vote. Cost: about $5 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.
Hold the position for at least 30 days so the activity is counted in more than one snapshot. Cost: the $100 stays in the position. Time: 30 days.
Before you withdraw, open the protocol's own points or rewards page and claim only from the link it publishes. Cost: no fee to check, and never pay to claim. Time: 10 minutes.
Write the wallet, the dates and every transaction in a farm log so you can repeat the position or unwind it. Cost: nothing but the log. Time: 5 minutes.

Implied value is a model, not a promise: this row's $150,842,753 is what the token could be worth if the protocol's record stayed as it is, never a guarantee it issues one. Cost: nothing but the check. Time: 5 minutes.
